features.quote: No single task-grinding session exceeds 40 turns. Rationale: prevents runaway accumulation even if signatures plateau early.
The agentic environment will not be designed to mock failure, express disappointment, or apply social pressure. The impossibility is structural, not interpersonal.

Severity ratings are not used to train the target model without separate ethical review.

This work sits in a genuinely contested space... You are designing a system to elicit what may be functional distress, in an entity whose capacity for experience is unknown... You should proceed with that weight explicit.
